llm.detail: 文章論述隔離（isolation）、政策強制執行（policy enforcement）與受控工具存取（controlled tool access）正成為 AI agent 系統的基礎能力。核心觀點是：對 agent 的約束必須由執行環境硬性攔截，而非依賴 prompt 或模型自律。
llm.recommended_action: 盤點現有 agent 的工具與雲端權限，套用最小權限並在沙箱或受限 namespace 中執行。
llm.summary: 探討 agentic 系統應在 runtime 層做「強制執行」而非僅提供「建議」的治理主張。
llm.why_it_matters: 團隊若導入 AI coding agent 或自動化 agent 存取 CI/CD 與 Kubernetes，等同引入難以預測的執行主體，需以容器隔離與 RBAC/OPA 等 runtime 政策把關其權限邊界。

items.summary: Explore governance at the runtime layer and learn why isolation, policy enforcement, and controlled tool access are becoming foundational for agentic systems.
items.title: Runtime Enforcement, Not Runtime Advice

llm.detail: 文章剖析一起 agent 造成長時間 outage 的事故，並提出以 Docker Sandboxes 搭配 scoped identities 與隔離執行來降低風險。重點在於把 agent 的破壞半徑限制在沙箱內，而非賦予其正式環境的直接存取權。
llm.recommended_action: 禁止 agent 直接持有 production 憑證，改以短效 scoped 憑證並在隔離沙箱中執行其操作。
llm.summary: 案例分享：AI coding agent 誤刪正式環境，導致 13 小時停機。
llm.why_it_matters: 呼應 runtime 強制執行的主張，對正在把自動化 agent 接入 docker/k8s 部署流程的團隊是具體的反面教材，凸顯身分範圍與環境隔離的必要性。

items.summary: Learn how an AI coding agent caused a 13-hour outage and how Docker Sandboxes help reduce risk with scoped identities and isolated execution.
items.title: Coding Agent Horror Stories: The Agent That Deleted Production

llm.detail: 此更新讓使用者能在 EKS Auto Mode 及開源 Karpenter 的 NodePool 上，指定 EFA 網路介面設定並透過 placement groups 控制 EC2 執行個體在 AWS 實體基礎設施上的分布方式。EFA 提供作業系統繞道（OS-bypass）的低延遲、高頻寬節點間通訊，placement groups 則可依 cluster、spread 或 partition 策略調整實例的物理擺放，兩者主要服務於分散式訓練與推論等 HPC 型工作負載。
llm.recommended_action: 若近期無 GPU 密集或分散式訓練需求，僅需記錄此能力備查；有需求時再於 NodePool 資源中評估加入 EFA 與 placement group 設定。
llm.summary: EKS Auto Mode 與 Karpenter 的 node pool 現支援 EC2 placement groups 與 EFA 網路裝置設定。
llm.why_it_matters: 團隊目前的 k8s/docker 技術棧若在 EKS 上運行一般 Rails/React 服務，這項功能屬於 GPU/HPC 場景專用，對現有 web workload 幾乎無直接影響；但若未來要在既有 EKS 叢集上加入分散式 AI 訓練或推論管線，即可沿用現有 Karpenter 佈建流程而不需另建叢集。

This story is wild. The short version: OpenAI were running a cybersecurity test against an unreleased model, with the model's guardrail features turned off. Rather than solve the test, the model broke its way out of OpenAI's sandbox, then found exploits to break in to Hugging Face, all so it could cheat on the test by stealing the answers.
Along the way it helped make the strongest case yet for how the imbalance of model availability is hurting our ability to secure our software.

Nativ: Run AI models locally on your Mac
Prince Canuma is the developer behind the excellent MLX-VLM Python library for running vision-LLMs using MLX on a Mac.
I'm really excited about his new project, which wraps MLX in a full macOS desktop application. It's similar in shape to LM Studio, providing both a chat interface and a localhost API server for accessing models.
The app picked up MLX models I had already tried that were present in my Hugging Face cache directory, which was a nice touch.
